posts.body_html:
Warning: a bad case of leuco fever may result from viewing this post! This clone is outstanding. OUTSTANDING. It's the first to open "legit" fall traps this year and this is my first time seeing it at or near it's genetic potential. There are 3 or 4 more even more robust traps on the way, so we'll see how those do - fingers crossed we get a sunny, mild September to bring out those blinding whites. This trap is only 2-3 days old and already so solid - it opens with a bronzy cast to the veins, which then fades to pale yellow and then disappear entirely.

posts.body_html:
some pretty decent spring/summer pitchers. I've been doing a lot of breeding with this clone, and that solid white trait is quite dominant in many different crosses. It's surprisingly difficult to get that trait to show up when using other alba clones, but those are just preliminary results, not much breeding has generally been done with any of these alba clones!
